title: Protocol and Vector Again
author: Odile Whitlock
blurb: Ulyana Winterbourne, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
